Refurbished from Apple: same 1-year warranty, up to 15% off.
Apple listing (Nov 2026): refurbished iPad mini (A17 Pro, Wi-Fi 128GB) $509 vs $599 new (Apple's was price). Our math: $90 saved, about 15%.
Apple says refurbished iPhones get a new battery and outer shell.
Amazon Renewed: 90-day guarantee. Renewed Premium: 1 year and a 90%+ battery.
62 million metric tons of e-waste in 2022; 22.3% documented recycled.
Sources: Apple, Amazon, UN Global E-waste Monitor 2024.
News and education, not financial advice.
